Title: WHALES similarity search on 600k molecules from Q-Mug
Description: Retrieves the 100 nearest neighbours of a query from Q-Mug, a collection of roughly 600,000 bioactive molecules drawn from ChEMBL with three conformers apiece. Ersilia assembled the search index; the similarity itself uses WHALES descriptors, which Grisoni and Schneider describe as encoding interatomic distances, molecular shape and partial charges together, and which were devised for scaffold hopping away from natural product templates. Three conformers are generated for the query too, so retrieval depends on conformer sampling.
Interpretation: The 100 closest Q-Mug molecules by WHALES shape and charge similarity across three generated conformers.
